motivation: The completed four-axis WorldClim secondary is an intentionally compact macroclimate test and does not exhaust environmental mechanisms relevant to flower-colour geography. This panel expands environmental representation without opening a variable-by-variable significance search.

process_blocks.ecological_content: mean temperature, temperature seasonality, warm extreme and cold extreme
annual precipitation, driest-month precipitation, precipitation seasonality and climatic moisture balance
atmospheric drying power, shortwave irradiance, growing-season heat accumulation and wind exposure

process_blocks.depth: thickness-weighted 0-30 cm mean from 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm layers
process_blocks.ecological_content: soil acidity, texture, organic carbon and cation-exchange capacity

process_blocks.aggregation: published 50-km median (md) product for each continuous variable where available
process_blocks.ecological_content: height, inclination, local surface roughness and three-dimensional terrain ruggedness

block_preprocessing.standardization: global terrestrial z-score separately for every input variable on the frozen source support
block_preprocessing.block_edge_score: sqrt(mean squared endpoint difference across the fixed standardized variables in that block)
block_preprocessing.reason_for_mean_squared_scaling: prevents blocks with more variables from receiving larger scores solely because of dimensionality

primary_edge_test.geometry: exact frozen RGFCA 200-outer, 250-species, 20-photo, spherical k=3 edge schedule
primary_edge_test.colour_score: same within-outer within-species midrank four-group JSD edge score
primary_edge_test.per_species_statistic: partial Spearman of ranked colour edge score and ranked environmental block contrast after residualizing both on ranked great-circle edge distance
primary_edge_test.global_statistic: equal-species mean of evaluable species partial rhos
primary_edge_test.null: same complete four-group colour-vector within-species permutations, master seed 2026090403, null indices 0..998 exactly once
primary_edge_test.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable process blocks in this five-block panel

decomposition_gate.individual_variable_multiplicity: Holm within the supported parent block

interpretation.supported_block: species-specific flower-colour discontinuities are concordant with a broad environmental process class beyond ranked geographic distance in this postoutcome secondary panel
interpretation.unsupported_block: does not establish that the process is absent; it means no common positive edge alignment was detected under the fixed block representation
